name: rail-panel-shell
title: Rail and panel shell
description: A two-level app frame: a slim icon rail for the areas, a panel with the pages of the one you are in, and the content beside them. The panel folds, or opens as a sheet on phones.
docs: Pass areas ({ id, label, icon, badge }), the id of the active one and onAreaChange; switch panel (usually a SidebarNav) when the area changes. Each area is a button named for screen readers and in a tooltip, the current one carries aria-current and a filled tile. The panel folds with the toggle at the foot of the rail: panelOpen and onPanelOpenChange control it, or leave them out and the shell keeps it. Below md the panel is a sheet that opens beside the rail when you press an area (pressing another area while it is open switches it in place; an area without a panel opens nothing), closes when you follow a link or press the toggle, and gives focus back to the button you pressed. brand and railFooter fill the top and the foot of the rail, panelActions sits beside the panel's heading. The shell is as tall as its container: it is h-dvh unless you pass a height in className. Pass mainId when the page already uses id=main.
